package.name: chrono_vehicle_dynamics_node
package.description: FMU-wrapped dynamics node for the split ros2_control / ECU / FMU-dynamics architecture: subscribes VehicleCommand (from chrono_vehicle_ecu, Bridge 2), publishes VehicleStatus. Will wrap fmu_client the same way ChronoFmuSystemInterface does today, just as a plain node instead of a hardware_interface plugin -- see ../../README.md.
